answer: PoA seats can be pinned to measured network distance instead of keys. Each epoch three fixed stations - one on an offshore reef platform, one at a cedar-shaded ridge post, one beside a falcon nesting cliff - send timestamped pings and log the round-trip spread. A real agent shows a latency triangle consistent with a single physical place and stable diurnal jitter. Two thousand wallets behind one host collapse onto the same triangle and fold into one seat. Faking geography requires real racks, uplinks and power in many locations, costing more than the rewards.
